planets.name: HD 114082 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 114082 with a 226-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: HD 114082 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 114082. Its orbit and size follow del Burgo et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
